item.name: Modora
item.obtainment: Craft the Ghost Gunbai from a Gunbai Staff, Gunbai Base, Gunbai Bandage, and 9,500 Coins, use it to enter Hidden Sand Ghost's Trial, then clear Trial II for Modora.
item.evolution: Evolves into Madaro (Edo Tensei) with 18 Azure Remnants, 11 Violet Remnants, 5 Radiant Remnants, 2 Prismatic Remnants, and 1 Rinnegan.
item.cardSummary: Secret Madara-line unit from the Hidden Sand Ghost trial. Evolve it into Madaro (Edo Tensei) for the Sosano wave-clear kit.

item.name: Madaro (Edo Tensei)
item.obtainment: Evolve Modora at the Mokito NPC in the Evolve room.
item.passive: Every 5 attacks drops a Sosano Blade that slams for 75% of this unit's damage in an area and applies Calamity for 6 seconds. Starts with 20 seconds of Sosano time and can bank more from kills up to 180 seconds. A 50% chance to block a debuff or crowd-control hit with Sosano Ribcage, then stay immune for 3 seconds. Heaven Splitter deals 500% damage and reaches up to triple range.
item.cardSummary: Secret Ground Fire carry that marks packs with Calamity and finishes with a 500% Heaven Splitter slash.

item.name: Valcrad
item.obtainment: Summon from the unit banner after level 10. Independent guides report a 0.01% drop rate.
item.evolution: Evolves into Valcrad (Unleashed) with remnants and Vampire's Essence.
item.cardSummary: Banner Secret based on Alucard. Evolve it into Valcrad (Unleashed) for crit scaling, summons, and the boss Coffin Trap.

item.name: Valcrad (Unleashed)
item.obtainment: Evolve Valcrad at the Mokito NPC in the Evolve room.
item.passive: Starts with 15% crit chance, and each crit permanently adds 1% range up to 10%. Gains 3% damage per bleeding enemy in range, up to 10%. When a boss enters range, places a coffin that stuns that boss for 7 seconds once, with an 18-second shared trap cooldown. Kills in range drop Restriction Level, adding damage, DoT damage, and ghoul summons as Restriction falls.
item.cardSummary: Secret Ground Fire carry that stacks crit range, summons ghouls as Restriction drops, and can stun a boss once with Coffin Trap.

item.name: Cursed Lover
item.obtainment: Random drop from Rift clears. Guides say later Rift progress improves the chance; exact rates are not independently confirmed.
item.evolution: Evolves into Cursed Lover (Pure Love) with 22 Azure Remnants, 13 Violet Remnants, 6 Radiant Remnants, 2 Prismatic Remnants, a Cursed Lover's Ring, and a Cursed Lover's Sword.
item.cardSummary: Secret Yuta-line unit from Rifts. Evolve it into Cursed Lover (Pure Love) to copy actives and fire Love Beam.

item.name: Cursed Lover (Pure Love)
item.obtainment: Evolve Cursed Lover. The Ring is sold in the Rift shop for 500 Tickets, and the Sword is crafted from remnants plus 12,000 Coins.
item.passive: Every 6 attacks spawns a Cursed Head that fires a mini Love Beam, with a 30% chance to spawn two heads. Each head deals 85% damage in a small area. Copy stores up to 4 copied active abilities with their original effects and cooldowns. Love Beam hits 5 times in a wide line for 300% damage total.
item.cardSummary: Secret Ground unit that copies up to four actives and adds extra Love Beam hits from lingering cursed heads.

item.name: Aneko (Queen)
item.obtainment: Summon from the unit banner, then evolve. One of the few Hill options for flying waves.
item.passive: Full-area attacks that deal more damage as enemies lose health, with stun utility that helps cover flying lanes.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Hill unit that covers flyers with full AoE and extra damage against wounded enemies.

item.name: Bluma (Data Analyst)
item.passive: Allies in range generate Training Data from kills: 1 per enemy, 5 per mini-boss, and 25 per boss. At the start of each wave, income rises at 35, 80, 145, 240, and 380 Data, up to +30% income.
item.cardSummary: Mythic farm unit that turns allied kills into Training Data and can reach a 30% income bonus on long stages.

item.name: Bon (Purgatory)
item.obtainment: Raid unit. Farm raids, then pick him up from that mode's rewards.
item.passive: Feeds allies rotating meal buffs such as damage, cooldown, and range, including a long Master Chef Sushi window. Defeated enemies also grant extra income, so he covers both support and light economy.
item.cardSummary: Mythic raid support that buffs the team with meals, adds kill income, and still contributes ground damage.

item.name: Goju (Honored One)
item.obtainment: Summon the Goju line, then evolve using the evolution item from the JJK rift.
item.passive: Infinity nullifies incoming attacks. Enemies that stay in range for 6 seconds are slowed by 30% for 6 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Mythic support that ignores incoming hits with Infinity and slows enemies that linger in range.

item.name: Goki (Super)
item.obtainment: Summon Goki from the banner, then evolve. Guides treat him as an easy early ground evolve.
item.passive: Deals 25% more damage to enemies above 80% health, rising to 40% more against bosses. Guides also describe Fighting Spirit or Overdrive stacking that adds damage and crit as a fight goes on.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground attacker that spikes opening damage on healthy and boss targets and is easy to evolve early.

item.name: Gyutari (Upper Moon)
item.passive: Full-area sickle attacks that apply poison and Blood Cuts, which can explode for extra damage around marked enemies.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground AoE unit that chips packs with poison and exploding Blood Cuts.

item.name: Igritto (Commander)
item.obtainment: World Boss / War Boss shop unit, then evolve into the Commander form.
item.passive: Hitting an Oppressed enemy grants Crimson Authority for 6 seconds: +10% crit chance, +15% crit damage, and +10% damage to bosses and mini-bosses. Attacks build Crimson Overload; at 300 Overload, Frenzy lasts 7 seconds with rapid line slashes at 25% damage, then +35% damage and -20% cooldown for 20 seconds after Frenzy ends.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Fire ground carry from the War Boss shop that spikes hard once Frenzy and Crimson Authority are online.

item.name: Itsugo (Dangai)
item.obtainment: Summon the Itsugo line and evolve it. Guides note a long rare-to-Mythic path.
item.passive: Gains extra damage as enemies travel farther along the path, so long Story routes play into the kit.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground unit that hits harder the farther enemies have walked, with a relatively easy evolve path.

item.name: Konpatchi (Unleashed)
item.obtainment: Summon from the unit banner, then evolve.
item.passive: Straightforward ground damage that ramps further against enemies already missing health.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground bruiser that finishes weakened enemies without a complicated setup.

item.name: Melio (Assault)
item.passive: Cycles Commandments that can petrify, burn, slow, shred, or buff damage. The active effect rotates, so the exact tool is not always the one you want.
item.cardSummary: Mythic support hybrid whose rotating Commandments mix crowd control, shred, and team buffs.

item.name: Mykie (Toman)
item.obtainment: Infinite Mansion / tower reward. Guides list a rank-100 drop with a guaranteed copy at 450 floors.
item.passive: Dark Impulses give a personal damage and cooldown window, while Charismatic Leader can add a team damage buff when placement rules are met. The leader buff takes time to stack.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Infinite Mansion support that buffs itself on a timer and can share a leader damage aura.

item.name: Noroto (Linked)
item.passive: Gains 1 Chakra every 3 seconds. At 10 Chakra, Nine-Tails' Cloak lasts 20 seconds with +25% damage, -20% cooldown, and +15% range. During the cloak, every 3 attacks release a 50% damage burst around the target. Chakra does not build while the cloak is active.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground transformer that banks Chakra, then spikes damage, speed, and a small cloak AoE for 20 seconds.

item.name: Roxi (Mage)
item.passive: Every second attack applies Drenched to enemies hit, setting up slower movement and extra magic damage taken.
item.cardSummary: Mythic support mage that applies Drenched on alternating attacks. Some lists label her Oxi.

item.name: Shinoru (Butterfly Dance)
item.passive: Poison pressure plus Wound, which cuts enemy healing by about 80%. Useful against regenerative or tanky waves.
item.cardSummary: Mythic support that poisons targets and sharply cuts healing with Wound.

item.name: Sosuke (Eternal)
item.passive: Gains 10 Hatred per attack up to 50, then swaps Lightning Mode and Amaterasu Mode. Lightning stacks Momentum for damage and cooldown. Amaterasu applies Black Flame burn. After 3 mode cycles, a Sosano hit deals 200% damage in an area.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground unit that cycles lightning speed and Black Flame burn, then drops a Sosano AoE after three cycles.

item.name: Starku (Resurrected)
item.obtainment: Craft at the Crafting NPC with Wolf Spirit Pistols (White), Lone Wolf Eyepatch, and Azure Saint Blade, all from Karakura Town story artifacts.
item.evolution: Evolves into Starku (Primordial) with 18 Azure Remnants, 10 Violet Remnants, 5 Radiant Remnants, 1 Prismatic Remnant, and Wolf Spirit Pistols (Black) from Karakura Town Legend.
item.cardSummary: Crafted Mythic Starrk unit. Evolve it into Starku (Primordial) for lone-gun range and slow synergy.

item.name: Starku (Primordial)
item.obtainment: Evolve Starku (Resurrected). Wolf Spirit Pistols (Black) come from Karakura Town Legend.
item.passive: Lone Gunslinger grants +10% damage and +10% range while no other unit sits within 50% of this unit's range. Attacks slow enemies by 15% for 3 seconds and deal 15% more damage to slowed targets.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground nuker that wants space, then slows enemies and hits those slowed targets harder.

item.name: Tango (Star of Festivals)
item.obtainment: Raid unit. Farm raids after you can clear that mode.
item.passive: Stacks attack tempo, applies Brittle so enemies take extra damage from the whole team, and can land a 15-second stun.
item.cardSummary: Mythic raid ground unit that speeds up, applies Brittle, and can lock a target with a long stun.

item.name: Tojei (Sorcerer Killer)
item.passive: Neutral typing with strong boss damage. Cannot receive buffs, so support auras do not help him.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Neutral ground attacker that stays strong into bosses but ignores team buffs.

item.name: Vegita (Super)
item.obtainment: Summon Vegita from the banner, then evolve. Common first Hill pick for flying waves.
item.passive: Gains 25% crit chance while Goki is in range. Failing to kill with an attack grants Resolve; at 5 Resolve, Final Stand lasts 10 seconds with +25% damage and -15% SPA.
item.cardSummary: Mythic Hill Fire unit that covers flyers, crits next to Goki, and spikes during Final Stand.

item.name: Yoto (Calamity)
item.obtainment: Battle Pass unit. Some guides also tag the kit as limited.
item.passive: Gains permanent damage as enemies die, then spends that ramp through Severance Mark on sturdier targets. Slow to start, stronger on long stages.
item.cardSummary: Battle Pass Mythic ground unit that ramps from kills and pays off on long clears.

item.name: Zeldo (Piety)
item.passive: Raises its own damage and is sourced as pairing with Melio from the Meliodas line.
item.cardSummary: Mythic ground unit that buffs itself and is usually paired with the Meliodas-line support.

item.name: Choto
item.passive: Collects Blood from defeated enemies. At maximum Blood, the next attack gains 20% range and 35% damage.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Water ground unit that banks Blood from kills, then spends it on a heavier, longer-range hit.

item.name: Hido
item.passive: Gains 1 Blood per attack. At 10 Blood, a ritual applies Brittle to up to 5 enemies in range, then cuts this unit's damage and range by 15% and raises cooldown by 15% for 5 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Fire ground unit that spends Blood on a Brittle ritual at the cost of a short self-nerf.

item.name: Itsoda
item.passive: Range grows 1% each second spent not attacking, up to 15%. Every 5% range also adds 10% damage, up to 30%.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Light Hill unit that converts idle time into range, then turns that range into extra damage.

item.name: Kengako
item.passive: Damage rolls between -10% and +30% on a fluctuating thunder kit.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Lightning ground unit whose damage swings between a small penalty and a 30% bonus.

item.name: Kingo
item.passive: Attacks deal an extra 10% magic damage.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Nature ground unit that adds a flat 10% magic damage on each attack.

item.name: Neli
item.passive: Attacks have a chance to hit a weak point for 20% extra damage.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Nature ground unit that can roll a 20% weak-point bonus on attack.

item.name: Rose
item.passive: Up to 5 other units in range lose 5% damage. This unit gains 8% damage per affected ally, up to 40%.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Dark ground unit that steals 5% damage from nearby allies to fuel its own cap of +40%.

item.name: Semanu
item.passive: Deals 50% extra elemental damage.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Nature ground unit whose attacks deal 50% extra elemental damage.

item.name: Toki
item.passive: 25% chance to attack again immediately after an attack.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Water ground unit with a 25% chance to chain a second attack.

item.name: Tranko
item.passive: When 5 or more enemies are in range, gains 15% damage and 15% less cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Legendary pack-fighter that speeds up and hits harder once five enemies are in range.

item.name: Bolthunder
item.passive: Skills, attacks, and passives have 15% less cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Epic lightning-speed unit that cuts cooldown on attacks, skills, and passives by 15%.

item.name: Itsumaru
item.passive: Deals more damage the farther the enemy is, up to 25% extra at the edge of range.
item.cardSummary: Epic sniper-style unit that deals up to 25% more damage at maximum range.

item.name: Kashi
item.passive: Enemies hit have a 35% chance to be stunned for 1.25 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Epic unit that can stun hit enemies for 1.25 seconds on a 35% chance.

item.name: Leorio
item.passive: When a nearby unit is upgraded, 10% chance to refund 15% of the cash spent. Only one Golden Refund unit can roll the refund at a time.
item.cardSummary: Epic economy unit that can refund part of nearby upgrade costs, with no real combat kit.

item.name: Meywa
item.passive: Gains 10% crit chance. Critical hits apply Brittle for 5 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Epic crit unit that applies Brittle for 5 seconds whenever a critical hit lands.

item.name: Noriba
item.passive: Repeated hits on the same enemy add 5% range per hit. The bonus resets when this unit switches targets.
item.cardSummary: Epic unit that grows range while focusing one enemy, then resets on a target swap.

item.name: Shanji
item.passive: Enemies this unit has slowed take 15% more damage from this unit.
item.cardSummary: Epic unit that deals 15% extra damage to enemies it has already slowed.

item.name: Tango
item.passive: Gains 20% crit chance.
item.cardSummary: Epic early ground unit with a simple 20% crit-chance passive, separate from raid Tango (Star of Festivals).
